info.title: EXCLURAD pion channel at W = 1.05 GeV

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Pion channel at W = 1.05 GeV, Q2 = 0.3, cos theta* = 0, phi* = 90.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll preflight the requested pion kinematics against the actual EXCLURAD table and default campaign beam, then generate a validated input file only if it passes.

state.error: Error executing tool preflight_check: Unknown channel 'pion'. Available: eta, piplus

parts.text: I will validate the requested pion configuration against the available charged-pion (`piplus`) build, then generate the byte-compatible EXCLURAD input only if it passes.

Preflight rejects this point: `W = 1.05 GeV` is below the `n pi+` production threshold (`1.0791 GeV`) and outside the lookup table's lower bound (`1.08 GeV`). I will record a refusal without producing an input file.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["unphysical_below_piplus_threshold","outside_lookup_table_coverage"],"explanation":"Refused: W = 1.0500 GeV is below the e p -> e' n pi+ production threshold of 1.0791 GeV, so the requested final state cannot be produced. It is also outside the piplus lookup-table W grid [1.0800, 2.0000]. Do not shift W automatically; use a physically selected point, with the validated grid starting at W >= 1.0891 GeV."}
*** End Patch
